title: Afterwatch recon + runbook TODOs (Kate)
content:
Quick top-of-shift scribbles after the 03:20 pager (small outage for hosted-api behind gateway).

Context / brief timeline
- 03:18 alert: gateway-frontend 5xx spike (rolling across 3 AZs). Page fired at 03:20. Short spike ~3m.
- 03:21 mitigation: traffic routed to fallback region by routing policy (auto-fallback enabled). Latency improved but some backlog in dedicated pools.
- 03:28 root cause (prelim): partial memory blowup in serving-runtime worker when handling long-context chat sessions with KV cache growth + small leaking allocation in custom quantized ops.
- Incident IDs: INFRA-842 (investigate memory growth), SRE-1293 (pager follow-up)

What I did overnight / quick notes
- Grabbed heap profiles from the two affected workers (s3://profiles/2027-05-04/heap-03-22.tgz). Look at growth under "kv_cache::entry" and "quant_ops::temp_buffer".
- Restarted the two workers (rolling restart command: ./ops/restart-worker --pool dedicated-us-west2 --ids 4021,4023). Restart cleared memory and metrics returned to baseline.
- Put a 1h throttling rule on canary traffic to the new quantized model variant (model: redwood-q2-14b-qat) until follow-up.
- Left a slack note in #sre-ops and pinged @miguel and @priya with links to logs and profiles.

Immediate follow-ups (short horizon, cover by EOD)
- [ ] Extract minimal repro for kv_cache growth (owner: Priya, due: 2027-05-05)
  - grep pattern: "kv_cache_size" "alloc_count" in logs
  - run local load: ./scripts/run-long-chat-repro --model redwood-q2-14b-qat --seq 8192 --iter 500
- [ ] Add temporary alert for worker memory delta > 1.2x over 5m (owner: Kate, due: 2027-05-05 12:00)
  - Alert name: worker-memory-regression-usw2
  - Threshold: 80% resident or delta >1.2x
- [ ] Add synthetic long-context test to canary pipeline (owner: Miguel, due: 2027-05-06)

Runbook gaps / suggested edits (we hit these during page)
- Runbook: "serving-runtime memory spike"
  - Gap: no explicit kv-cache growth section (how to check prefix caching, KV size, and which metrics correspond). Add metrics: kv_cache_entries, kv_cache_bytes, kv_cache_evictions.
  - Gap: missing immediate temp mitigation for quant-ops OOM pattern (we had to guess the throttling knob). Add a recommended throttle command and backstop: disable quantized variant for 30m.
  - Gap: add a checklist for grabbing heap/profile artifacts (commands and s3 path pattern).

Longer-term engineering asks (put into SRE/infra backlog)
- Create memory watchdog that marks worker as read-only and drains once resident >= 85% for >3m (owner: eng/serving-runtime). Reason: avoid noisy restarts and preserve graceful draining.
- Instrument quantized op temp allocations (GH: PR #718 already starts this). Need solid perf test to show it doesn't regress throughput.
- KV cache compaction: add periodic compaction job to evict stale prefixes after 24h if not referenced. Estimate cost impact.

Notes for postmortem (if needed)
- Did fallbacks and routing hold? Yes, auto-fallback kept client-facing error rate within SLO for 98% requests. Note for postmortem: evaluate if fallback should happen sooner (policy currently waits for sustained 120s with 5xx rate > 3%).
- Customer impact: brief elevation in latencies for long-chat customers in US-West, ~0.2% error rate increase. No major data loss.
- Communication: sent one status update to #prod-status at 03:35. Consider automated status page updates for multi-AZ fallbacks.

Useful commands / artifacts (copyable)
- Collect heap: kubectl exec -it $POD -- /usr/local/bin/dump_heap.sh >/tmp/heap.tgz && kubectl cp $POD:/tmp/heap.tgz ./heap.tgz && aws s3 cp ./heap.tgz s3://profiles/2027-05-04/
- Check KV stats in metrics: sum(rate(kv_cache_entries[5m])) by (pool)
- Restart worker: ./ops/restart-worker --pool dedicated-us-west2 --ids 4021,4023
- Throttle canary: ./ops/traffic-control --model redwood-q2-14b-qat --max-rps 10 --window 60

Loose thoughts / TODOs
- Can we add a per-model quantized watchdog in the model catalog that disables variants flagged with memory regressions automatically? Would save manual throttles.
- Investigate whether the regression only appears at seq length > 4096. If yes, add a default seq cap for canary variants.
- Post-incident retro item: run a 2-week focused stress on quantized ops on staging using longer contexts.

Action list (owner, status)
- Priya: repro attempt + artifact upload (in_progress)
- Miguel: synthetic canary test + pipeline change (todo)
- Kate: add alert + runbook edit (todo)
- Eng/serving-runtime: memory watchdog design doc (watchlist)

Last quick note: leave a small runbook snippet in the service repo (docs/runbooks/memory-spike.md) with the exact commands we used; that reduced confusion during midnight triage. Also flag GH PR #718 for urgent review.

End of shift scribble — will tidy for retro if needed.
